summary: Sign in with email and password

identity.description: The user's email address, not case sensitive

code.description: A current TOTP code or an unused backup code, only when MFA is on; without it the answer is an MFA challenge

mfa_challenge.summary: MFA is on and no code was sent

200.description: The session cookie is set and its expiry returned, or an MFA challenge

description:
Checks the credentials and sets the session cookie (valid 1 hour); the answer holds only its expiry. With MFA on and no `code`, it sets a challenge cookie (valid 3 minutes) and answers `requiresTotp`: finish with POST /tokens/totp, or send `code` (a TOTP or backup code) in the same request. It answers 403 when OIDC is the only sign-in. 5 failed requests per address in 5 minutes block that address for the rest of the 5 minutes.

Needs: nothing (public)
